description:
The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has a requirement for landscaping and snow removal services at three (3) FAA facilities located in Nashua, New Hampshire: 

 
	 ZBW Air Route Traffic Control Center (ARTCC), 35 Northeastern Blvd, Nashua, NH 03062 
	 ZBW Child Care Facility, 53 Northeastern Blvd, Nashua, NH 03062 
	 ZBW Operational Support System (OSS), 11 Murphy Drive, Nashua, NH 03062 
 

 All work shall be accomplished in accordance with the attached SIR and attachments. It is anticipated that a stand-alone contract with firm fixed-Price pricing arrangement will be awarded as a result of this solicitation. The NAICS code applicable to this requirement is 561730. The business size standard for this NAICS is $9.5M. 

  

 Contractors must be registered with the System for Award Management (SAM) www.sam.gov on the date established for receipt of proposals. Reference AMS Clause 3.3.1-33, paragraph (d), "if the offeror does not become registered in the SAM database in the time prescribed by the Contracting Officer, the Contracting Officer may proceed to award to the next otherwise successful registered Offeror." 

  

 The FAA reserves the right to review and verify each offeror’s program eligibility. Potential offerors should note that the FAA reserves the right to communicate with one or more offerors at any time during the SIR process. This SIR is not to be construed as a contract or a commitment of any kind. The Government shall not be liable for payment of any costs attributed to the preparation and submission of proposals. 

  

  Note:  The FAR references cited in SAM.gov are   not applicable   to the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) as the FAA has its own policies and guidance referenced in the Acquisition Management System (AMS). 

  

 Please note the following dates: 

 
	  Site Visit (Optional):   4 December 2026 at 13:00 ET. In order to attend, vendors must  RSVP no later than  30 Nov 2026 at 15:00 ET, as specified in the SIR. 
	  Vendor Questions:  Must be submitted no later than 7 December 2026 at 15:00 ET. Questions must be submitted  in writing.  
	  Proposals Due:  15 December 2026 at 15:00 ET. 
 

 Additional information and submission instructions are included in the SIR (attachment 697DCK-27-R-00016).
